qa_pairs.question: What is the final torque specification for S14/S38 B35 cylinder head bolts?
How long is the setting time required during the cylinder head bolt installation sequence?
What is the initial torque value for S38 B36/S38 B38 cylinder head bolts?
What are the torque angle specifications for the S38 B36/S38 B38 cylinder head bolts?
Which engine types use the torque sequence with 50 Nm, 80 Nm, 15 min setting time, then 100 Nm?
What is the difference in the tightening procedure between S14/S38 B35 and S38 B36/S38 B38 cylinder head bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: S14/S38 B35 uses a torque sequence (50 Nm, 80 Nm, 15 min setting time, 100 Nm), while S38 B36/S38 B38 uses torque plus angle method (20 Nm, then 60°, then 70°)
